part_number.product: SEL-451-6 Protection, Automation, and Bay Control System (Sampled Values / TiDL, 8U-capable chassis)

prefix.description: SEL-451 Protection, Automation, and Bay Control System; position 5 selects the sub-model/firmware (6 = SEL-451-6)

part_number.note: 25-digit Model Option Table for the SEL-451-6 (long/8U-capable string decoded by WI-15509). Positions 6 (connector type), 15 (Ethernet connection), 16 (mounting) and the I/O board slots at 18/20/22 are anchored by the 8U configuration drawings (i7301-i7306); the remaining positions come from WI-15509 and were confirmed against the instruction-manual VER sample part number. Positions 11-13 (00X) and 24-25 (XX) are fixed/reserved template digits. This is distinct from the shorter 3U SEL-451/-5 string (drawings i7014c/i7061c) whose digit meanings differ.
references: SEL-451-6 With Sampled Values or TiDL Technology Ordering Information (WI-15509, 20231221)
SEL-451-5 With 8U Chassis Ordering Information (WI-13119, 20190731) - shared I/O board / voltage tables
SEL-451 8U master configuration drawings i7301.B-i7306.B (drawing layers: connector, Ethernet, mounting, I/O board positions B/C/D)
SEL-400 Series Instruction Manual, VER command sample (Part Number: 04516XX0X600XE9H4C4XXXXXX)

example_part_numbers.note: SEL-451-6 VER sample from the SEL-400 Series instruction manual (fixed digits genuine; X = wildcard/unspecified). Decodes: 125-250 V PS, Ethernet protocol E (IEC 61850 + SV subscription), Ethernet option 9 (SFP), Horizontal Rack, 4U one I/O board, I/O board B = C (24 opto inputs / 8 outputs) @ 125 Vdc. VER confirms Ethernet Config 9 (SFP ports), IEC 61850, Board 1 = 24 in/8 out.
